_comment: S1-d sinks decomposition. Pre-registered in PREREGISTRATION.md BEFORE running, with a QUANTITATIVE prediction (capacity model predicts |delta| ~0.0008 nats, ~25x below our 0.021 detection floor at n=5) so that a null is a successful prediction rather than an absence. Only the swa(w=64, sinks=0) lane is new - exact and swa-sinks1 already exist at matched seeds in experiments/sparse_s1 (400 steps) and experiments/sparse_s1_budget (1200 steps), so every comparison is paired. Also certifies the only cross-engine-comparable configuration: coalfire.cpp has no sink support.
